g2p_engine_primary_rationale: L2 / SC7-002: GPLv3 espeak-ng dropped due to license incompatibility with Apache-2.0 + Mac App Store. AVSpeechSynthesizer phoneme delegate is Apple system framework, no license issue. SC4-006 + SC6-18 acknowledged: Korean phoneme coverage in AVSpeechSynthesizer is Apple's internal SAPI scheme; mapping below covers the cases observed in demo utterances + 50-utterance test set.
g2p_engine_fallback_chain: Bundled Hangul jamo class table (Apache-2.0, see hangul_jamo_classes below)
Bundled IPA→viseme mapping (CC0; first-row fallback when AVSpeech delegate emits IPA on edge cases)
_comment_en: English IPA → 16-viseme. Maps follow the Disney/Preston Blair convention with Apple SAPI alignment notes.

æ.rationale: low front; near AA in PB convention

n.rationale: tongue-tip alveolar; visually similar mouth aperture to S/SH

k.rationale: velar; no distinct visible mouth shape; default open

_comment_ko: Korean IPA → 16-viseme. Per SC4-006: Hangul vowels not cleanly mapping to PB English set; choices below favor visible lip-aperture similarity. SOURCE.md beard occlusion mitigates mismatch perception. Loanword fallback uses ipa_to_viseme_en first.

ʌ.rationale: ㅓ; mid back unrounded; visually closer to AA than UH due to wider aperture

ɯ.rationale: ㅡ; high back unrounded; closest English equivalent UH despite different lip rounding

ø.rationale: ㅚ; rounded mid front; nearest in our set is OH

y.rationale: ㅟ; high front rounded; nearest is OW

p.rationale: ㅂ ㅍ ㅃ; aspirated/tense not distinguished visually

k.rationale: ㄱ ㅋ ㄲ; velar, no visible distinction

_comment_hangul_jamo_classes: Per-syllable fallback when phoneme delegate fails. Maps Hangul jamo Unicode classes to viseme buckets. SC3-019.

hangul_jamo_classes._pass_note: ㅇ as initial is silent (zero-onset); the syllable's viseme is determined by the medial vowel only.

korean_primary: 그 노래를 처음 들은 건 누구와 함께였나요
english_primary: Why does some music make me cry

_validation_step: Build pipeline runs spec/test-fixtures/g2p-validation.swift over the utterances above; each utterance must produce a complete viseme timeline (zero REST-because-unmapped frames). See spec/performance-test-suite.md.
